med_tabii.title: Natural Madd
med_tabii.rule: When a madd letter is not followed by a hamza or sukoon, it is elongated for two counts.

0.explanation: The alif acts as a natural elongation letter.

1.explanation: The waw acts as a natural elongation letter.

idgam_meal_gunne.title: Idgham with Ghunnah
idgam_meal_gunne.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by one of the Yemnu letters, it is merged with ghunnah.

0.explanation: The Noon meets Ya, so Idgham occurs.

1.explanation: The Noon meets Meem, so Idgham occurs.

idgam-bila-gunne.title: Idgham without Ghunnah
idgam-bila-gunne.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by Lam or Ra, it is merged without ghunnah.

0.explanation: The Noon meets Ra, so Idgham without ghunnah occurs.

1.explanation: The Tanween meets Lam, so Idgham without ghunnah occurs.

ihfa.title: Ikhfa
ihfa.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by an Ikhfa letter, the Noon sound is concealed with a nasal sound.

0.explanation: The Calm Noon meets Za, so Ikhfa occurs.

1.explanation: The Calm Noon meets Shin, so Ikhfa occurs.

izhar.title: Izhar
izhar.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by a throat letter, the Noon sound is pronounced clearly.

0.explanation: The Calm Noon meets Kha, so Izhar occurs.

1.explanation: The Tanween meets Alif, so Izhar occurs.

iklab.title: Iqlab
iklab.rule: If Sakin Noon or Tanween is followed by Ba, the Noon sound is converted to Meem with ghunnah.

0.explanation: The Sakin Noon meets Ba, so it changes to Meem.

1.explanation: The Tanween meets Ba, so it changes to Meem.

kalkale.title: Qalqalah
kalkale.rule: When the letters of Qalqalah are calm, they are pronounced with an echoing vibration.

0.explanation: Qaf is calm, so Qalqalah occurs.

1.explanation: Dal is calm, so Qalqalah occurs.

ra_hukmu.title: Rules of Ra
ra_hukmu.desc: How the letter Ra is pronounced
ra_hukmu.rule: Ra with fatha or dhamma is heavy, Ra with kasra is light. In sukoon form, the previous vowel determines the reading.

0.explanation: Ra with fatha is read heavily.

med_muttasil.title: Connected Madd
med_muttasil.rule: When a madd letter is followed by a hamza in the same word, it becomes Connected Madd and is read longer.

0.explanation: The alif and hamza are in the same word, so the sound is elongated longer.

tenvin.question: What is Tenvin?
tenvin.answer:
Tenvin is the sound effect of the letter nun at the end of the word. There are three types:
• Fethatan (ً): Superior tanvin
• Kesretan (ٍ): Esre tanvin
• Dammetan (ٌ): Otre tenvin
Tenvin is the reading of the nun at the end of the word without writing it.

gunne.question: How to read in a sunny way?
gunne.answer:
It is the nasal reading of the letters gunne, nun and mim. Two movement amounts are kept.
• Idgam (mealgunne): If ي، ن، م، و comes after Nun calmine
• Ihfa: If there are 15 letters after Nun calmine (ت ث ج د ذ ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ف ق ك)
• Iklab: If ب comes after Nun Sakine, it turns into mime and is read as gunneli.

kalkale.question: Which are the letters Kalkale?
kalkale.answer:
There are 5 letters of Kalkale and they are memorized with the word "قطب جد":
• ق (Kaf), ط (Ti), ب (Ba), ج (Cim), د (Branch)
When these letters are calm (inflected), a bounce or vibration is made at the starting point.

med.question: What are the letters Med?
med.answer: The extension (Med) letters are three: Elif (ا), Vav (و) and Ya (ي). These letters lengthen the letter before them by one elif amount (approximately 1-1.5 seconds).

makhraj.question: What is Mahraj?
makhraj.answer: Mahrec is the place where letters come out of the mouth. While reading the Quran, it is very important to extract the letters from their correct origins so that the meaning is not distorted.

ihfa.question: How is Ihfa done?
ihfa.answer: Ihfa means to hide in the dictionary. When the letters of ihfa come after the calm nun or tanvin, it means reciting the nun sound by nasally and slightly hiding it.

sekte.question: What is secta?
sekte.answer: Sekte means stopping the sound for a moment and waiting without breathing. There are interruptions in 4 places in the Holy Quran (in the Surahs al-Kahf, Yasin, Kiyame and Mutaffifin).

izhar.question: What is Izhar?
izhar.answer: Izhar means reading clearly. If the throat letters (ء ه ح خ ع غ) come after the tranquil nun or tenvin, the sound of the nun is read as it is, without being held or hidden.
